recipes.name: Green Goodness Sandwich
instructions: Add all the tofu whip ingredients to a food processor.
Spread pesto over half of the bread and tofu whip on the other half. Top with the veggies and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † We used a version of pide called Ramazan pidesi, a thicker round pide. * Tofus vary in moisture. Add a splash of water or extra-virgin olive oil if needed for a smoother texture.

Storage It's best enjoyed the day it's made but the assembled sandwich can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 1 day. The tofu whip can be made in advance and stored in the fridge for up to 3 days. It might have some water separate from it, that can be drained off or stirred back in before using.
